title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：livestock　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 livestock 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the herder ① raised the livestock that no villager in the pasture would have counted, and he said the raising was the whole of the season. The ② livestock, meaning the stock itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; livestock, he said, is the only thing in a pasture that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ head of livestock in that pasture had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ livestock at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Livestock, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the herder said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the livestock was the whole of the matter, meaning the herd and not the stock. The ⑥ livestock, meaning the herd and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; livestock, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both stock and a herd. He said the herd is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ livestock had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ livestock of the whole thing, the herder wrote in September, was one pasture and three seasons of counting; livestock, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ livestock I remember is the livestock counted in the ledger, which closed in 1975 and is still counted as the quietest in the pasture. ⑩ Livestock, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all livestock, she said, is a herd that has agreed to look like stock. She said the herd was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 牲畜；家畜（指牧场里每一头旁边的那一头）
B. n. 牲畜；家畜（指那群牲畜本身，与栅栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise the livestock 饲养这一群牲畜
D. n. 牲畜；家畜（指留给孩子们喂的那一头那一群）
E. n. 牧养之事（抽象总称，指一处牧场的牲畜之事）
F. n. 牲畜；家畜（指牧群台账里写到、被清点的的那一群）
G. n. 牧群、生计（指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 生计（抽象总称，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: raised the livestock that no villager in the pasture would have counted
The livestock, meaning the stock itself and not the fence
Every head of livestock in that pasture
the livestock at the far shed
the livestock was the whole of the matter
the livestock had become a line in a ledger
The livestock of the whole thing

answers.why: raise the livestock 意为“饲养这一群牲畜”，1968 年那位牧民把牧场里没有一位村民肯清点的一头牲畜做了一遍。
livestock 意为“牲畜；家畜”，指那群牲畜本身而不是栅栏，它经过了三个牧季而在簿子上没有被清点。
livestock 意为“牲畜；家畜”，指牧场里每一头旁边的那一头，每一头旁边都有同一道短短的栅栏。
livestock 意为“牲畜；家畜”，指最远那间棚舍留给孩子们喂的那一头那一群，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
livestock 意为“牧群、生计”，指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份生计就是那件事的全部。
livestock 意为“生计”，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西而不是那群牲畜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
livestock 意为“牲畜；家畜”，指牧群台账里写到、被清点的的那一群，到 1973 年这一群成了牧群台账里的一行。
livestock 意为“牧养之事”，牧民九月写道，整件事的牲畜之事是一处牧场和三个牧季的清点。
livestock 意为“牲畜；家畜”，我记得的是牧群台账里清点过的那一群，1975 年点完了，至今仍被说成牧场里最安静的一群。
livestock 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，牲畜是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的牲畜。
